metadata.name: bario_seeker_program
metadata.description: Bario Seeker — soulbound provenance, grading and geotagged journey checkpoints for Bario rice

instructions.name: add_checkpoint
docs: Append a geotagged, priced stop. Distributor or Retailer role required.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the platform config and the global producer Collection.
Runs once per deployment.

accounts.name: producer_collection
docs: The `Bario Seeker Producers` Metaplex Core Collection.
A PDA rather than a fresh keypair, so its address is derivable by any
client without being told — the verification page can find every
producer certificate from the program ID alone.
constrained by these seeds and it must not already exist.

instructions.name: rate_batch
docs: Rate a batch 1-5 stars. One rating per wallet per batch.

instructions.name: record_audit
docs: Record an independent lab audit. Auditor role required.
Re-audits append; they never overwrite.

accounts.name: auditor
docs: Must hold the Auditor role. This is the check the whole trust chain
rests on, so it lives here rather than in a backend that could be
bypassed or misconfigured.

instructions.name: record_scan
docs: Record a consumer scan at ~1 km precision. Permissionless; a relayer pays.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The relayer. Pays rent and fees on the consumer's behalf.

accounts.name: scan
docs: Scans live under their own seed namespace so they never interleave with
the supply-chain journey — the route line and the heat layer are
separate readings of the same primitive.

instructions.name: register_actor
docs: Grant a wallet the Auditor, Distributor or Retailer role. Admin only.

instructions.name: register_batch
docs: Register a harvest lot: mints its soulbound certificate into the
producer's Collection and writes checkpoint #0 at the farm.

accounts.name: batch_asset
docs: The Batch SBT.

accounts.name: farm_checkpoint
docs: Checkpoint #0 — the farm. Written in the same transaction as the batch
so that no batch can ever exist without an origin.

instructions.name: register_producer
docs: Register a Bario producer: validates the farm is in the highlands,
mints their soulbound identity, and creates their harvest Collection.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The farmer's wallet. Pays for its own registration and ends up owning
the Producer SBT — though it will never be able to move it.

accounts.name: producer_asset
docs: The Producer SBT.

accounts.name: batch_collection
docs: This producer's own Collection, which will hold their batch SBTs.
Creating it here is what makes "batch is a child of producer"
structural rather than a claim we ask people to believe.

instructions.name: report_counterfeit
docs: File a counterfeit report against a batch. One per wallet per batch.

accounts.name: reporter
docs: The reporter, or a relayer acting for a consumer with no wallet.

instructions.name: set_actor_active
docs: Withdraw or restore an actor's accreditation. Their existing
checkpoints are deliberately left in place.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the platform admin may perform this action

errors.name: ActorNotRegistered
errors.msg: Signer is not registered as an actor on this platform

errors.name: ActorInactive
errors.msg: This actor's registration has been deactivated

errors.name: WrongRole
errors.msg: Signer does not hold the role required for this action

errors.name: NotAuditor
errors.msg: Only a registered auditor may record a grade

errors.name: OutsideBarioBounds
errors.msg: Farm coordinates fall outside the Bario highlands

errors.name: ElevationTooLow
errors.msg: Farm elevation is below the 1,100 m highland threshold for Bario rice

errors.name: InvalidCoordinates
errors.msg: Coordinates are not a valid point on Earth

errors.name: TextTooLong
errors.msg: Text field exceeds its maximum length

errors.name: TextEmpty
errors.msg: Text field must not be empty

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidBagCount
errors.msg: Bag count must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be greater than zero for this checkpoint kind

errors.name: InvalidRating
errors.msg: Rating must be between 1 and 5

errors.name: InvalidGrade
errors.msg: Grade must be A1, A2 or B — Pending cannot be recorded by an audit

errors.name: InvalidCheckpointKind
errors.msg: This checkpoint kind cannot be submitted through this instruction

errors.name: BatchProducerMismatch
errors.msg: Batch does not belong to the producer account provided

errors.name: CheckpointBatchMismatch
errors.msg: Checkpoint does not belong to the batch account provided

errors.name: InvalidHarvestDate
errors.msg: Harvest date is implausible

errors.name: CounterOverflow
errors.msg: A counter overflowed — this batch or producer has reached its limit

fields.name: active
docs: Accreditation can be withdrawn without erasing the actor's history.

types.name: ActorRole
docs: Supply-chain participants other than producers and consumers.
Roles are checked on-chain rather than in the backend, because the trust
claim in the PRD ("only an accredited auditor sets a grade") is only worth
making if a rogue backend cannot forge it.

fields.name: index
docs: Must equal the batch's current `checkpoint_count`.

fields.name: label
docs: e.g. "Tesco Pavilion, Kuala Lumpur".

fields.name: price_sen
docs: Sen per kg at this stop.

fields.name: note_cid
docs: IPFS CID for a delivery note or shelf photo. May be empty.

types.name: Batch
docs: One harvest lot, certified as a child of its producer.

fields.name: producer
docs: The `Producer` PDA this batch belongs to.

fields.name: asset
docs: Batch SBT — a frozen Metaplex Core asset in the producer's Collection.

fields.name: grade
docs: The most recent audited grade. Earlier grades are never erased — they
remain readable as `Audit` checkpoints.

fields.name: farmgate_price_sen
docs: What the farmer was paid, in sen per kg.

fields.name: checkpoint_count
docs: Next index in the journey checkpoint sequence.

fields.name: audit_count
docs: How many audits this batch has had. >1 means it was re-audited.

fields.name: scan_count
docs: Next index in the consumer scan sequence.

types.name: Checkpoint
docs: One append-only, geotagged event in a batch's life.
This is the single primitive behind four features: the consumer journey map,
the price journey, the audit history, and the scan-anomaly signal. No
instruction in this program mutates or closes a checkpoint once written.

fields.name: batch
docs: The `Batch` PDA this checkpoint belongs to.

fields.name: index
docs: Position in its sequence. Journey checkpoints and consumer scans are
numbered separately and live under different seeds.

fields.name: actor
docs: The wallet that submitted this checkpoint. For consumer scans this is
the relayer, not the consumer — consumers never hold a wallet.

fields.name: lat
docs: Micro-degrees.

fields.name: price_sen
docs: Sen per kg. Zero where the kind carries no price.

fields.name: grade
docs: Set on `Audit` checkpoints only.

fields.name: note_cid
docs: IPFS CID for photos or the audit report. Empty where there is none.

types.name: CheckpointKind
docs: What happened at a checkpoint.
The kind determines who is allowed to submit it and how the verification
page draws it — journey kinds form the route line, `ConsumerScan` forms the
heat layer underneath it.

types.name: Config
docs: Platform-wide singleton. Owns the global producer Collection and acts as the
update authority for every Metaplex Core asset the program mints, which is
what makes the soulbound guarantee hold: the freeze authority is this PDA,
and no private key controls it.

fields.name: admin
docs: May register actors and hand over admin.

fields.name: producer_collection
docs: The `Bario Seeker Producers` Metaplex Core Collection.

types.name: Grade
docs: Audited quality classification.
`Pending` is the state between registration and the first audit. It is a
real state, not a null: a bag can legitimately be in the supply chain before
its lab result comes back, and the verification page must say so plainly
rather than implying a grade the batch has not earned.

types.name: Producer
docs: A registered Bario farmer or cooperative.
One per wallet, enforced by the PDA seeds. Mirrors the on-chain state that
backs the Producer SBT, and holds the running reputation aggregate so the
verification page can render a score without replaying every review.

fields.name: authority
docs: The producer's wallet. Owns both SBTs but cannot move them.

fields.name: asset
docs: Producer SBT — a frozen Metaplex Core asset.

fields.name: batch_collection
docs: This producer's own Core Collection, holding their batch SBTs.

fields.name: farm_lat
docs: Farm location in micro-degrees, validated against the Bario bounding box.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: Digest standing in for an off-chain identity verification record.
No personally identifying data is ever written on-chain.

fields.name: rating_sum
docs: Quantity-weighted reputation: sum of (stars x batch kg) over all reviews.

fields.name: rating_weight
docs: Sum of batch kg over all reviews. Score = rating_sum / rating_weight.

fields.name: index
docs: Must equal the batch's current `checkpoint_count`. Passing it explicitly
makes a concurrent write fail loudly instead of overwriting a stop.

fields.name: lat
docs: Where the audit was carried out, in micro-degrees.

fields.name: label
docs: e.g. "Sarawak Rice Laboratory, Miri".

fields.name: report_cid
docs: IPFS CID of the full audit report.

fields.name: index
docs: Must equal the batch's current `scan_count`.

fields.name: lat
docs: Approximate consumer location in micro-degrees. Clients must truncate to
~1 km before sending; the program snaps to the same grid regardless.

fields.name: label
docs: Coarse place name, e.g. "Kuala Lumpur". Never a street address.

fields.name: batch_code
docs: Human-readable lot code, e.g. "2026-11-001". Part of the PDA seeds, so
it is unique per producer and cannot be reused.

fields.name: farmgate_price_sen
docs: What the farmer was paid, in sen per kg.

fields.name: note_cid
docs: IPFS CID for harvest photos. May be empty.

fields.name: farm_lat
docs: Farm location in micro-degrees.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: Digest of an off-chain identity verification record. No PII on-chain.

fields.name: asset_uri
docs: Metadata URI for the Producer SBT.

fields.name: collection_uri
docs: Metadata URI for this producer's batch Collection.

types.name: Report
docs: A counterfeit report against one batch.
Recording a report on-chain makes the signal tamper-evident and gives the
regulator a spatial feed. It is deliberately *not* a public accusation: the
PRD requires every report to route to a human, and the producer to have a
right of reply, before anything is shown to consumers.

fields.name: lat
docs: Coarsened to the same ~1 km grid as consumer scans.

types.name: Review
docs: A consumer rating of one batch.
Seeded by (batch, reviewer) so one wallet can rate a batch exactly once.
Review prose lives off-chain; only its CID is anchored here.

fields.name: rating
docs: 1..=5 stars.
